```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r}
sample_list <- read_rds(here::here("data","derived","run_001_sample_list.rds"))
plate_assignments <- read_rds(here::here("data","derived","run_001_plate_assignments.rds"))
```

# Prep data for lib_prep_book 

## Prep overview

```{r, overview cols}
overview_cols <- c(
  "plate_num","num_samples","sample_descr","project_id","sample_type", "status",
  "extr_method","extractor","PCR_1er","pmix","pmix_nM","PCR_2er","i7"
)
```

```{r}
overview_sheet <- plate_assignments %>%
  group_by(plate_num) %>%
  summarise(
    num_samples = n(),
    project_id  = paste(sort(unique(project_id)), collapse = ", "),
    sample_type = paste(sort(unique(sample_type)), collapse = ", "),
    extr_method = paste(sort(unique(extr_method)), collapse = ", "),
    sample_descr = paste(sort(unique(sample_descr)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(status = NA) %>%
  mutate(extractor = NA) %>%
  mutate(PCR1_er = NA) %>%
  mutate(pmix = "pmix_004") %>%
  mutate(pmix_nM = case_when(
    extr_method == "chelex" ~ "80nM",
    extr_method == "magbind" ~ "40nM",
    TRUE ~ NA
  )) %>%
  mutate(PCR2_er = NA) %>%
  mutate(i7 = as.character(row_number())) %>%
  mutate(i7 = case_when(
    i7 == "25" ~ "misc", 
    TRUE ~ i7
  ))
```

## Prep quant

```{r}
quant_cols <- c(
  "plate_num","well_id","sample_type",
  "extr_quant","extr_dil_rate","extr_dil_quant","extr_dna_added","extr_h20_added",
  "pcr1_quant","pcr1_dil_rate","pcr1_dil_quant","pcr1_dna_added","pcr1_h20_added",
  "pcr2_quant"
)
```

```{r}
build_quant <- function(quant_input) {
  stopifnot(all(c("plate_num","well_id","sample_type") %in% names(quant_input)))

  quant <- quant_input %>%
    mutate(
      extr_quant = NA,
      extr_dil_rate = NA,
      extr_dil_quant = NA,
      extr_dna_added = NA,
      extr_h20_added = NA,
      pcr1_quant = NA,
      pcr1_dil_rate = NA,
      pcr1_dil_quant = NA,
      pcr1_dna_added = NA,
      pcr1_h20_added = NA,
      pcr2_quant = NA
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(extr_dil_rate, extr_dil_quant, extr_dna_added, extr_h20_added),
        ~ if_else(sample_type == "swab","NA", .)
      )
    )

  # Order columns (with disambiguated h2o columns)
  quant %>%
    select(
      plate_num, sample_type, well_id,
      extr_quant, extr_dil_rate, extr_dil_quant, extr_dna_added, extr_h20_added,
      pcr1_quant, pcr1_dil_rate, pcr1_dil_quant, pcr1_dna_added, pcr1_h20_added,
      pcr2_quant
    )
}
```

```{r}
quant_input <- overview_sheet %>%
  select(plate_num, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(col_num = ((plate_num - 1) %% 10) + 1) %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(row_letter = LETTERS[1:8]) %>%
  mutate(
    well = str_c(row_letter, str_pad(col_num, width = 2, pad = "0")),
    well_order = match(row_letter, LETTERS[1:8])  # A=1 ... H=8
  ) %>%
  select(plate_num, sample_type, well, well_order) %>%
  bind_rows(
    overview_sheet %>%
      select(plate_num, sample_type) %>%
      tidyr::expand_grid(well = c("H11", "H12")) %>%
      mutate(well_order = if_else(well == "H11", 9L, 10L)) %>%
      select(plate_num, sample_type, well, well_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(plate_num, well_order) %>%
  select(-well_order) %>%
  rename(well_id = well)

quant_sheet <- build_quant(quant_input)
```

Small tweaks to quant sheet

```{r}
quant_sheet <- quant_sheet %>%
  mutate(extr_quant = case_when(
    well_id == "H11" | well_id == "H12" ~ "NA",
    TRUE ~ extr_quant
  )) %>%
  mutate(
      across(
        c(pcr1_quant,pcr1_dil_rate,pcr1_dil_quant,pcr1_dna_added,pcr1_h20_added),
        ~ if_else(well_id == "H12","NA", .)
      )
    )
```

## Prep plate sheets

```{r}
plate_cols <- c(
  "ind_id","tube_id","project_id","sample_descr","sample_type",
  "extr_method", "extr_plate","extr_well",
  "pmix", "pmix_nM","PCR1_well", "PCR1_dilut_well","PCR2_well",
  "i5","i7","pool"
)
```

```{r}
# All 96 wells in your preferred order (A1..A12, B1..B12, ... H12)
wells_96 <- as.vector(
  t(
    outer(
      LETTERS[1:8],
      str_pad(1:12, width = 2, pad = "0"),
      paste0
    )
  )
)

# Use 94 wells, reserving H11/H12 for the blank control rows
wells_94 <- setdiff(wells_96, c("H11", "H12"))
```

```{r}
plate_sheet <- plate_assignments %>%
  mutate(
    sample_descr = NA_character_,
    extr_plate   = plate_num
  ) %>%
  group_by(plate_num) %>%
  mutate(extr_well = wells_94[row_number()]) %>%
  ungroup()

# Two control rows per plate
control_rows <- plate_sheet %>%
  distinct(plate_num) %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(extr_well = c("H11", "H12")) %>%
  mutate(extr_plate = plate_num)

# Add ALL missing columns as NA, then match column order
missing_cols <- setdiff(names(plate_sheet), names(control_rows))

control_rows <- control_rows %>%
  mutate(!!!set_names(rep(list(NA), length(missing_cols)), missing_cols)) %>%
  select(all_of(names(plate_sheet)))

# Bind and order so controls are last within each plate
plate_sheet <- plate_sheet %>%
  bind_rows(control_rows) %>%
  arrange(
    plate_num,
    factor(extr_well, levels = c(wells_94, "H11", "H12"))
  )

plate_sheet <- plate_sheet %>%
  group_by(plate_num) %>%
  mutate(i5 = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(i7 = case_when(
    plate_num == 25 ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ as.character(plate_num)
  )) %>%
  mutate(pool = 4)

plate_sheet %>%
  select(extr_well)
```

```{r}
ensure_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) df[missing] <- NA
  df %>% select(all_of(cols))
}
```

```{r}
make_workbook <- function(overview_sheet, quant_sheet, plate_sheet,
                          out_file = "workbook.xlsx", n_plates = 25) {

  # --- Overview ---
  overview <- overview_sheet %>% ensure_cols(overview_cols)

  # --- Quant ---
  quant <- quant_sheet

  # --- Plate sheets ---
  plates_tbl <- plate_sheet
  stopifnot("plate_num" %in% names(plates_tbl))
  plates_tbl <- plates_tbl %>% ensure_cols(c("plate_num", plate_cols))

  wb <- createWorkbook()

  # Styles
  style_center <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")
  style_left   <- createStyle(halign = "left",   valign = "center")

  # Helper: apply alignment rules to a sheet
  apply_alignment <- function(wb, sheet, df, include_header = TRUE) {
    cn <- names(df)
    n_rows <- nrow(df)
    if (n_rows == 0) n_rows <- 1  # so templates still get styled

    # Excel rows: header is row 1
    rows_to_style <- if (include_header) 1:(n_rows + 1) else 2:(n_rows + 1)

    # Column indices by name (if present)
    plate_col <- which(cn == "plate_num")
    left_cols <- which(cn %in% c("ind_id", "tube_id"))
    center_cols <- setdiff(seq_along(cn), left_cols)

    # Force plate_num to be centered (already included in center_cols, but explicit is fine)
    # Apply center everywhere except ind_id/sample_id
    addStyle(wb, sheet, style_center,
             rows = rows_to_style, cols = center_cols,
             gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

    # Apply left to ind_id/sample_id
    if (length(left_cols) > 0) {
      addStyle(wb, sheet, style_left,
               rows = rows_to_style, cols = left_cols,
               gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

  # -------------------------
  # Sheet 1: Overview
  # -------------------------
  addWorksheet(wb, "Overview")
  writeData(wb, "Overview", overview, colNames = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb, "Overview", firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, "Overview", cols = 1:ncol(overview), widths = "auto")
  apply_alignment(wb, "Overview", overview, include_header = TRUE)

  # -------------------------
  # Sheet 2: Quant
  # -------------------------
addWorksheet(wb, "Quant")
writeData(wb, "Quant", quant, colNames = TRUE)
freezePane(wb, "Quant", firstRow = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "Quant", cols = 1:ncol(quant), widths = "auto")
apply_alignment(wb, "Quant", quant, include_header = TRUE)

# --- Add thick line after each plate (after H12 row) ---
thick_bottom <- createStyle(border = "Bottom", borderStyle = "thick")

# Make sure quant has well_id and is ordered by plate then well
stopifnot("well_id" %in% names(quant))
quant <- quant %>% arrange(plate_num, well_id)

# rows (in quant data) where a plate ends (H12)
end_rows <- which(quant$well_id == "H12")

# If your wells are padded like "H12" but others are "H01" etc, this is still fine.
# Convert to Excel row indices: +1 because row 1 is the header row in Excel
end_rows_excel <- end_rows + 1

# Apply thick bottom border across all columns on those rows
addStyle(
  wb, "Quant", thick_bottom,
  rows = end_rows_excel,
  cols = 1:ncol(quant),
  gridExpand = TRUE,
  stack = TRUE
)

  # -------------------------
  # Plate sheets 1..n_plates
  # -------------------------
  for (p in seq_len(n_plates)) {
    sh <- as.character(p)   # sheet names should be strings
    addWorksheet(wb, sh)

    plate_df <- plates_tbl %>%
      filter(plate_num == p) %>%
      select(all_of(plate_cols))

    if (nrow(plate_df) == 0) {
      plate_df <- tibble(!!!set_names(rep(list(NA), length(plate_cols)), plate_cols))[0, ]
    }

    writeData(wb, sh, plate_df, colNames = TRUE)
    freezePane(wb, sh, firstRow = TRUE)
    setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1:length(plate_cols), widths = "auto")
    apply_alignment(wb, sh, plate_df, include_header = TRUE)
  }

  saveWorkbook(wb, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  invisible(out_file)
}
```

```{r}
make_workbook(overview_sheet,quant_sheet,plate_sheet,out_file = here::here("data","derived","run_001_lib_prep.xlsx"))
```
